doc.title: Chuck Findley interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 6, 2023

title: Wife's grandmother Pilar Arcos
summary: Findley says Pilar Arcos was his wife's grandmother, a Cuban-born singer who recorded thousands of titles.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Yeah. This has just been a fantastic conversation. I’ll just wrap up with maybe two things. I understand that you did some jamming with Pilar Arcos?
Oh Arcos. That’s my wife’s grandmother.

She was a famous Latin, from Spain, opera singer pretty much. I mean she did — back in the early ‘20’s I guess it was, she did, she was with RCA Victor and what other — my wife — what other label, honey? Oh Brunswick as well. But that was when they did titles you know, one title. And she would go in to the studios and do these different titles. And she recorded, jeez, thousands of titles you know back in the day. And she would travel and she was very big in South America and traveled all over. She was born in Cuba and from a circus family you know. So I married into a family of circus people, entertainers you know.
Well you came out of a family of musicians too so you’ve got it surrounded.
